en: Illustrated postcard showing a historic stone castle with a large round tower, crenellated walls, and surrounding buildings, set against a mountainous backdrop at sunset. At the top it is labeled in Italian with the city name and the castle name. Along the left side is a vertical printed caption and on the right the printer/publisher's details. At the bottom is a circular medallion with a portrait of a man in profile and Latin text around it, and beneath that an area filled with handwritten Italian text and a date.
